items.name: St. Elmo's Striker
items.weapons: St. Elmo's Engine or Eagle Bearer (primary) · GR9 LMG (secondary)
items.note: Sustained AR damage off a simple stacking loop — Striker's Gamble stacks and St. Elmo's shock ammo keep uptime easy. Eagle Bearer's guaranteed-crit-after-miss is a strong exotic swap-in, and Overdog gloves are the current best-in-slot exotic pairing if you have them.
items.best: Heroic missions, raids, sustained boss damage

items.name: Pakhan Striker
items.weapons: Pakhan LMG (primary) · GR9 LMG (secondary)
items.note: Obliterate stacks +1% weapon damage per crit for 5s (up to 25 stacks) on top of Striker's Gamble's own stack — Pakhan's big magazine and steady rate of fire keep both piles topped up through a whole encounter, even though Pakhan alone ranks below Bluescreen/Iron Lung/Pestilence on raw weapon power.
items.best: Legendary bosses, raid ability phases, long sustained fights

items.name: Core Strength Memento
items.weapons: Capacitor or St. Elmo's Engine (primary) · ACS-12 (secondary)
items.note: Core Exercise converts a slice of your off-core bonuses, giving balanced damage, armor, Skill Tier and recovery from one set.
items.best: Solo farming, open world, flexible content

items.name: Iron Will Hotshot
items.weapons: Prima Donna MMR, Dread Edict or Mantis (primary) · Model 700 or SR-1 (secondary)
items.note: Iron Will's Resolved talent converts your next body shot into a headshot every two seconds — inherits the endless-conversion role Determined used to fill. Any Marksman Rifle keeps Headache's consecutive-headshot bonus climbing, so lean on whichever exotic or high-end MMR you actually have.

items.name: Aces & Eights Iron Will
items.weapons: Merciless or Diamondback (primary) · a reliable High-End pistol (secondary)
items.note: Red Horizon buffed Dead Man's Hand hard — reveal a five-card hand while landing MMR/Rifle shots and your next shot gets a 75% damage amp (100% with the set's own No Limit chest talent, traded away here for Iron Will). Headshots flip extra cards, so Iron Will's free headshot conversions speed the whole loop up.
items.best: Farming, Legendary missions, precision rifle DPS

items.name: Hunter's Fury Ouroboros
items.gear: Hunter's Fury (4pc) + Memento or Sokolov backpack
items.weapons: Ouroboros SMG or Backfire (primary) · M870 (secondary)
items.note: Apex Predator debuffs nearby enemies while armor-on-kill keeps you topped up brawling at close range.
items.best: Control Points, Summit floors, Heroic farming

items.name: Refactor Force Multiplier
items.weapons: Capacitor (primary) · Harmony (secondary)
items.note: Return to Sender turns skill damage back into armor, so you can play skills aggressively from a distance without dying.
items.best: Legendary missions, solo content needing distance

items.name: Ember Engine Fafnir
items.weapons: Fafnir exotic shotgun (primary) · Pyromaniac (secondary)
items.note: Spontaneous Combustion converts any status effect into a burn chance; Fafnir's Dragon's Breath shells stack right on top. Vile and Overdog gloves are the two exotics getting cited most for this build right now — grab whichever drops first.

items.name: Future Initiative Healer
items.weapons: Scorpio or Designated Hitter (primary) · Lefty (secondary)
items.note: Ground Control converts your armor into a group damage buff while teammates stay topped up — the most reliable group healer in the game.

items.name: Negotiator's Dilemma
items.weapons: Pestilence LMG (primary) · high-RPM AR (secondary)
items.note: Hostile Negotiations marks targets on crit and redistributes damage between them — note Pestilence's plague damage doesn't crit or transfer through marks.

items.name: Tipping Scales LMG
items.weapons: Big Alejandro, Bluescreen or Bullet King (primary) · GR9 with Steady Handed (secondary)
items.note: Throttle Control ramps up to 100% bonus weapon damage the longer you fire from cover — built for stationary boss DPS windows. Any of the three exotic LMGs work; use whichever you own.

items.name: Eclipse Protocol Foam
items.weapons: Scorpio (primary) · Test Subject (secondary)
items.skills: Riot Foam Chem Launcher · Stinger Hive
items.note: Indirect Transmission spreads status effects to nearby enemies when a carrier dies — locks down packed rooms almost for free.

items.name: Ongoing Directive Support
items.weapons: Carnage or GR9 LMG (primary) · Scorpio (secondary)
items.note: Rules of Engagement hands the whole group Hollow-Point Ammo, amplifying teammates' weapon damage by up to 40%.

items.name: Heartbreaker PvE
items.weapons: Carbine 7 / Police M4 / FAMAS with Flatline (primary) · ACS-12 shotgun (secondary)
items.note: Flatline primes targets; shooting a pulsed enemy stacks bonus damage and armor together.

items.name: Model 700 Headhunter (Full Red)
items.weapons: Model 700 with Determined (primary) · Nemesis or SR-1 (secondary)
items.note: Since the Determined rework, this build needs real headshot kills before the conversion window opens — no more infinite chains.

items.name: Model 700 Headhunter (Hybrid)
items.weapons: Model 700 with Determined (primary) · Nemesis (secondary)
items.note: Same core loop as the full-red version, traded for enough Blue to survive Heroic directives comfortably.

items.name: Hunter's Fury Determined
items.gear: Hunter's Fury (4pc) + Chainkiller chest + Memento backpack
items.weapons: 1886 Rifle with Determined (primary) · Nemesis (secondary)
items.note: Works at mid-to-close range instead of long sightlines, using Apex Predator's armor recovery to stay alive near enemies.
items.best: Heroic farming at closer engagement distances

items.name: Foundry Bulwark Tank
items.weapons: Any reliable AR or shotgun for utility damage
items.note: Makeshift Repairs converts incoming damage on your shield into repairs — the standard raid tank set for holding aggro through mechanics.

items.name: Ortiz: Reficere Healer
items.weapons: Caduceus (primary) · a reliable SMG (secondary)
items.note: Burst healing that grants temporary Hazard Protection against Burn, Bleed and Shock — the pick for status-heavy Legendary rooms.
items.best: Legendary missions with heavy status damage

items.name: Negotiator's Dilemma (Focused)
items.gear: Negotiator's Dilemma (4pc) + Pristine Example chest + Contractor's Gloves
items.weapons: Police M4 / FAMAS / Carbine 7 with 8x scope and Flatline (primary) · rifle with 8x (secondary)
items.note: Perfect Focus rewards sustained scoping; marks distribute crit damage across the group's targets.

items.name: Eclipse Protocol Foam (Legendary)
items.gear: Eclipse Protocol (4pc) + Electrique backpack with Creeping Death + Golan Gear holster
items.weapons: Scorpio (primary) · Lefty (secondary)
items.note: Foam locks enemies down while Creeping Death spreads the effect further — built for the hardest crowd-control rooms.

items.name: Negotiator's Dilemma (Raid)
items.weapons: Pestilence LMG (primary) · high-RPM AR (secondary)
items.note: Same loadout as the open-world version — one of the two go-to support-damage sets alongside Ongoing Directive for ability phases.

items.name: High-End AR Crit
items.gear: High-End mix: Ceska, Grupo, Contractor's Gloves, Fox's Prayer
items.weapons: Lexington / FAMAS / Police M4 with a PvP talent (primary) · Ouroboros, Vector or M870 (secondary)
items.note: No gear-set requirement — brand bonuses alone give steady, consistent weapon damage without a build-defining talent to counter-play around.

items.name: Capacitor NinjaBike
items.gear: NinjaBike Messenger Bag + Unit Alloys, Ceska, Fenris, Picaro's Holster, Grupo
items.weapons: Capacitor (primary) · shotgun or high-RPM SMG (secondary)
items.note: Capacitor's weapon damage scales off your Skill Tier, so this loadout stacks brand bonuses instead of committing to one gear set.

items.name: Core Strength Capacitor
items.gear: Core Strength (4pc) + NinjaBike backpack + Picaro's Holster
items.weapons: Capacitor (primary) · shotgun or SMG (secondary)
items.note: Core Exercise's cross-core conversion smooths out the same Capacitor scaling with less brand-juggling than the NinjaBike version.

items.name: Striker Bighorn
items.weapons: The Bighorn with a scope (primary) · Vector or an SMG (secondary)
items.note: Bighorn's automatic unscoped mode covers close range while Striker's stacks pile on damage the longer a fight runs.

items.name: Iron Lung LMG
items.gear: Catharsis, Walker/Gila, Fenris/Golan/Belstone, Contractor's Gloves, Belstone Armory, Emperor's Guard
items.weapons: Iron Lung LMG (primary) · Dark Winter or an SMG (secondary)
items.note: Heat buildup applies Burn over a sustained fight, and the suppression disrupts enemy movement while you hold a lane.

items.name: Ravenous Rifle
items.gear: Catharsis, Walker, Ceska/Grupo, Contractor's Gloves, Picaro's Holster, Fox's Prayer
items.weapons: The Ravenous (primary) · FAMAS, FAL or an SMG (secondary)
items.note: Alternating shots apply offensive and defensive primers; detonating them delivers a controlled burst instead of raw sustained DPS.

items.name: Chatterbox Striker
items.weapons: The Chatterbox SMG (primary) · Vector or MPX (secondary)
items.note: Chatterbox's rate of fire climbs after reloading near an enemy, layering on top of Striker's own stacking damage.

items.name: Heartbreaker PvP
items.weapons: Police M4 / Carbine 7 / FAMAS with Flatline (primary) · ACS-12 shotgun (secondary)
items.note: Flatline triggers off pulsed targets specifically — pair it with a pulse skill and stacking damage + armor snowballs in trades.

items.name: Hunter's Fury SMG PvP
items.gear: Hunter's Fury (4pc) + Ceska/Grupo/Sokolov backpack with Adrenaline Rush + chest with Unbreakable
items.weapons: Ouroboros or Vector (primary) · M870 or an SMG (secondary)
items.note: Extra damage against nearby enemies plus armor recovery on kills — built to dive fights and keep diving.

items.name: Umbra Peek-Shooter
items.weapons: Merciless or Diamondback (primary) · ACS-12 (secondary)
items.note: Umbra Initiative pays out separate buffs for being in and out of cover, so the loop is popping out, landing one big semi-auto hit, and dropping back down before the enemy can punish the exposure.
items.best: Aggressive Dark Zone and Conflict peek-fights

items.name: Rigger Double Skill
items.weapons: Capacitor or Harmony (primary) · a reliable High-End shotgun (secondary)
items.note: Tend and Befriend rewards running two or more skills that support each other — Rigger just wants uptime on both, so a weapon that doesn't need constant attention is the priority.

items.name: Hard Wired Cooldown Loop
items.gear: Hard Wired (4pc) + a Skill Haste backpack
items.weapons: Capacitor or Harmony (primary) · a reliable High-End shotgun (secondary)
items.skills: Assault Turret · Striker Drone · Reinforcer Chem Launcher
items.note: Feedback Loop shaves cooldown off your other skills every time one goes on cooldown itself, so it wants three skills stacked and cycling rather than one held back for a big moment.
items.best: Skill-spam solo play, dense enemy waves

items.name: True Patriot Marked DPS
items.weapons: GR9 LMG or Carbine 7 (primary) · Liberty (secondary)
items.note: Red, White and Blue stacks three separate debuffs onto one marked target — the longer you keep shooting that target, the harder everyone else's damage lands too.
items.best: Boss phases that reward focusing a single marked target

items.name: Tip of the Spear Signature Loop
items.weapons: Your specialization's signature weapon — TAC-50 C, Explosive Tipped Crossbow, M32A1, M134 Minigun, P-017 Seeker Launcher, or K8-JetStream
items.spec: Match whichever specialization you're built around
items.note: Aggressive Recon only cares about landing hits with your equipped signature weapon, so the set slots into any specialization without changing your loadout otherwise.

items.name: System Corruption Self-Repair
items.weapons: St. Elmo's Engine or FAMAS (primary) · a reliable High-End AR (secondary)
items.note: Hackstep Protocol swaps your armor kit for a fresh one instantly on a short cooldown, so you can keep pushing AR damage without breaking off to find cover and heal manually.
items.best: Solo farming that punishes stopping to heal

items.name: Cavalier Cover DPS
items.weapons: ACS-12 or Scorpio (primary) · GR9 LMG (secondary)
items.note: Charging and Charged both reduce incoming damage while you're behind cover, so it rewards a patient, cover-heavy playstyle over aggressive pushing.
items.best: Legendary rooms with heavy incoming fire

items.name: Ortiz: Exuro Turret Burn
items.weapons: Fafnir or Iron Lung (primary) · a reliable SMG (secondary)
items.note: Incinerator Turret Prototype is doing most of the damage here — bring a weapon that also applies Burn so the turret isn't carrying the fight alone.

items.name: Aegis Focus-Fire Tank
items.weapons: ACS-12 or GR9 LMG (primary) · St. Elmo's Engine (secondary)
items.note: Stoic cuts damage from enemies actively focusing you, which pays off most while you're planted in one spot holding a lane — a dependable AR or shotgun is all the weapon synergy it needs.
items.best: Holding chokepoints, tanking add pressure off the group

items.name: Breaking Point Rifle Stacks
items.weapons: Merciless or Diamondback (primary) · a reliable High-End rifle (secondary)
items.note: On Point stacks bonus damage specifically off rifle shots, so it wants semi-auto or burst rifles landing consistent hits rather than a full-auto spray.

items.name: Virtuoso Range-Swap
items.weapons: Scorpio or M870 (close) · Model 700 (long)
items.note: Symphony changes which bonus you get based on your current engagement range, so the build wants two genuinely different weapons in your loadout rather than two variations on the same range.
items.best: Solo content with mixed close and long engagements

items.name: Measured Assembly Huddle
items.weapons: Scorpio or Lefty (primary) · Designated Hitter (secondary)
items.skills: Restorer Hive · Reinforcer Chem Launcher · Stinger Hive
items.note: Huddle grants Skill Tier bonuses for staying near allies, so it's a pure support slot — weapon choice comes down to personal comfort more than any real synergy.

items.name: Concentrated Company Marked Kills
items.weapons: Police M4 or FAMAS (primary) · Regulus (secondary)
items.note: Camaraderie pays out group-wide bonuses when a marked enemy dies, so it wants a weapon that can reliably finish off whatever your pulse just marked.
items.best: Group farming with a dedicated marking skill
